issues.where: crop B (368,164) and crop C (1328,164), star field
issues.what: the encoded side drops a share of the faintest stars and dims others, so the field looks thinner than the source; the bright stars all survive
issues.fix: lower the encoder's psy/AQ smoothing on dark flat areas, or add a little bitrate to the dark regions so single-pixel stars are kept

issues.where: crops D (368,704) and E (1328,704), dark space beside the limb
issues.what: faint background stars near the planet edge thin out after encoding, and the dark ground is slightly smoothed; no banding or blocking is visible
issues.fix: same as above: protect low-luma detail with lower deadzone or a stronger aq-mode in dark areas

issues.where: crop C (1328,164) and crop H (1120,106), thin spark streaks
issues.what: the finest spark filaments are a bit softer and lower contrast in the encode; the arcs are still clean, with no ringing or blocks
issues.fix: acceptable at this bitrate; if needed, give more bits to high-motion bright detail

issues.where: crops D and E, granulation surface
issues.what: the darkest intergranular lanes lose slight micro-contrast, but the cells still look detailed and not mushy
issues.fix: no change required; this is the expected loss of fine grain
